[[bench]]
name = "benchmarks"
harness = false

[package]
name = "flash-lso"
version = "0.6.0"
authors = [ "CUB3D <callumthom11@gmail.com>",]
description = "Fast and safe SOL/AMF0/AMF3 parsing. Supports serde, Adobe flex and cyclic references"
repository = "https://github.com/CUB3D/rust-sol"
readme = "README.md"
license = "MIT"
keywords = [ "sol", "amf", "parser", "serializer", "flash",]
edition = "2024"
categories = [ "data-structures", "encoding", "parser-implementations",]

[dependencies]
nom = "=8.0.0"
enumset = "=1.1.13"
thiserror = "=2.0.18"

[dev-dependencies]
pretty_assertions = "=1.4.1"
serde_json = "=1.0.150"
criterion = "=0.8.2"

[features]
default = [ "amf3",]
flex = []
serde = [ "dep:serde", "enumset/serde",]
all = [ "serde", "flex",]
amf3 = []

[dependencies.serde]
version = "=1.0.228"
optional = true
features = [ "derive", "rc",]

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = [ "cfg(fuzzing)",]

[package]
name = "h263-rs"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = [ "Mike Welsh <mwelsh@gmail.com>",]
edition = "2018"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[dependencies]
bitflags = "2.4.0"
thiserror = "2.0.3"
num-traits = "0.2.16"

[package]
name = "h263-rs-deblock"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = [ "TÖRÖK Attila <torokati44@gmail.com>",]
edition = "2018"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[dependencies]
wide = "1.7.1"
itertools = "0.15.0"

[package]
name = "h263-rs-yuv"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = [ "Mike Welsh <mwelsh@gmail.com>",]
edition = "2018"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[dependencies]
wide = "1.7.1"
bytemuck = "1.13.1"

[package]
name = "jpegxr"
version = "0.3.1"
authors = [ "Brooke Vibber <bvibber@pobox.com>",]
edition = "2018"
license = "BSD-3-Clause"
description = "Wrapper for Microsoft's C JPEG XR image codec library"
readme = "readme.md"
homepage = "https://github.com/brion/jpegxr"
repository = "https://github.com/brion/jpegxr.git"
keywords = [ "jxr", "jpegxr", "jpeg-xr",]
categories = [ "multimedia::images",]

[dependencies]
thiserror = "2.0.3"
libc = "0.2.153"

[build-dependencies]
bindgen = "0.73.0"

[build-dependencies.cc]
version = "1.0.83"
features = [ "parallel",]

[package]
name = "nellymoser-rs"
version = "0.1.2"
authors = [ "relrelb <relrelbachar@gmail.com>",]
edition = "2021"
description = "A pure Rust decoder for the Nellymoser audio codec"
license = "MIT"

[dependencies]
bitstream-io = "4"
once_cell = "1.10.0"
rustdct = "0.7.0"

[package]
name = "nihav_codec_support"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = [ "Kostya Shishkov <kostya.shishkov@gmail.com>",]
edition = "2018"

[dependencies.nihav_core]
path = "../nihav-core"

[package]
name = "nihav_duck"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = [ "Kostya Shishkov <kostya.shishkov@gmail.com>",]
edition = "2018"

[dependencies.nihav_core]
path = "../nihav-core"

[dependencies.nihav_codec_support]
path = "../nihav-codec-support"

[package]
name = "regress"
version = "0.10.3"
authors = [ "ridiculousfish <corydoras@ridiculousfish.com>",]
description = "A regular expression engine targeting EcmaScript syntax"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/ridiculousfish/regress"
keywords = [ "regex", "regexp",]
edition = "2021"
readme = "README.md"

[workspace]
members = [ "regress-tool", "gen-unicode", ".",]
default-members = [ "regress-tool", ".",]

[features]
default = [ "backend-pikevm", "std",]
std = [ "memchr/std",]
backend-pikevm = []
index-positions = []
prohibit-unsafe = []
utf16 = []

[dependencies]
hashbrown = "0.16.1"

[profile.release]

[dependencies.memchr]
version = "2.4.0"
default-features = false

[package]
name = "ruffle_api_report"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.69"
serde_json = "1.0.93"
fnv = "1.0.7"

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4.1.8"
features = [ "derive",]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.152"
features = [ "derive",]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/ruffle-rs/rust-flash-lso"]
git = "https://github.com/ruffle-rs/rust-flash-lso"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "61b717248aae853a4f5d8a103eba704268d286c8"

[source."https://github.com/ruffle-rs/h263-rs"]
git = "https://github.com/ruffle-rs/h263-rs"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "27ee833ca97aadd2a14cf0b3b4ec8b53f31ff6bd"

[source."https://github.com/ruffle-rs/jpegxr"]
git = "https://github.com/ruffle-rs/jpegxr"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "86cc1749d493288f53d7290ac3eb7082c475b5d9"

[source."https://github.com/ruffle-rs/nellymoser"]
git = "https://github.com/ruffle-rs/nellymoser"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/ruffle-rs/nihav-vp6"]
git = "https://github.com/ruffle-rs/nihav-vp6"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "12d0bdf10a85641dc2de3d6900c747894431ed77"

[source."https://github.com/ruffle-rs/regras3"]
git = "https://github.com/ruffle-rs/regras3"
